title: MorphoLemma suite case
description: One use case run through the full suite. Every stage is REQUIRED to be present: a stage may be 'not_done' or 'not_applicable', but it may not be absent, so a skipped stage is always visible. A stage marked 'done' must point to an evidence file and carry that file's SHA-256. Paths are relative to the folder holding the case file. suite-gate.mjs enforces this schema by hand (no validator dependency) plus the cross-stage rules listed under x-gate-rules.

toy.description: true for fixtures; a toy case may never be counted in a suite total.

statement.description: The claim in plain words with its source. Evidence: the file holding the verbatim quote and its DOI/URL.

source.description: DOI, arXiv id or URL that was actually opened.

lean.description: The formal statement. Evidence: the saved check.sh log for the .lean file, not the .lean file alone.

theorems.description: Fully qualified theorem names the case relies on. Each must have its own '#print axioms' line in the log.

axioms_allowed.description: Allow-list, normally [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Any other axiom in the log fails the case.

negative_control.description: A deliberately false variant that the kernel must reject.

named_hypotheses.description: Every hypothesis the theorem is conditional on; each needs its own evidence in validation.

prereg.description: Thresholds and metrics fixed before any number. Evidence: the PREREG file.

dated_by.description: What vouches for hashed_utc. 'self-attested' (a time written by the same process that wrote the result) is a WARNING: the order cannot be checked by a third party.

date_proof.description: Commit hash, or path to an OpenTimestamps/RFC 3161 receipt. Required unless dated_by is self-attested.

holdout.description: The evaluation data the claim never saw. Evidence: the leak-gate log (check-leaks output) for this case's files.

holdout_set.description: What is held out, described WITHOUT naming a frozen clade (e.g. 'frozen clade per holdout/split.json', 'specimens 31-49', 'papers after 2024').

min_n_for_verdict.description: From a power analysis; n_holdout below this means 'underpowered', never 'pass'.

validation.description: The check against real data or simulation. Evidence: the machine-readable result file.

command.description: One command that regenerates the evidence from a clean clone.

fail_once.description: The check run with a fault injected into the DATA or MODEL (not merely an inverted predicate); it must fail.

performance.description: Any number offered as 'how well it did'. Evidence: the result file the number is read from.

evaluated_on.description: Only 'holdout' may be described as a pass on real data.

name.description: The trivial alternative: null model, untouched organism, majority class, previous method.

broken_input_control.description: The same pipeline run on shuffled labels, a wrong-sign parameter or a violated assumption; it must NOT pass.

what_was_wrong.description: Required even when everything passed. Evidence: the RUNS/deviations file.

nanopub_draft.description: The unsigned record. Evidence: the draft file.

signed.description: Drafts only; signing is a human decision.

quotable_line.description: The one sentence a reader would quote; it must be true on its own, with the caveat inside it.

x-gate-rules.S1: every one of the eight stages is present
x-gate-rules.S2: status is one of done/failed/not_done/not_applicable; anything but done carries a reason
x-gate-rules.S3: a done stage has evidence.path that exists and whose SHA-256 equals evidence.sha256
x-gate-rules.P1: performance done => prereg done, with hashed_utc strictly before performance.computed_utc
x-gate-rules.P2: performance done => prereg evidence file hash still matches (the prereg was not edited afterwards)
x-gate-rules.P3: performance done => baseline with name, numeric value and an evidence file that exists and matches its hash
x-gate-rules.P4: performance done => broken_input_control with observed == fail and an evidence file that exists and matches
x-gate-rules.P5: performance verdict 'pass' with evaluated_on == holdout => holdout stage done, leak_gate_exit == 0, n_holdout >= min_n_for_verdict
x-gate-rules.P6: performance verdict 'pass' is not allowed when evaluated_on is in-sample
x-gate-rules.L1: lean done => negative_control observed == fail, and at least one theorem named
x-gate-rules.W1: what_was_wrong must be done with at least one item whenever performance is done
x-gate-rules.N1: nanopub_draft done => signed is false; and performance not done => no nanopub_draft done
